$Comment: Kill XP for Hallow's Eve's four creatures, on a server running MMO Skill Tree. Only that mod reads
this folder, so without it the file is never loaded.
A pattern is matched as a substring of the creature's role id and the longest match wins, so each
row names one role by its whole id and reaches only that role, ahead of the shorter patterns MMO
Skill Tree ships (Ghoul, Skeleton, Wraith) the other three would otherwise fall to. Without its row
a Lost Soul would fall to the plain fallback. The value is the XP a kill is worth before any boost.
Name: Mmo_Hallows_Eve
